verification_note: let binds a name, readable immediately; a subsequent let reassigns the same name; if/while block bodies share the ENCLOSING scope (no new lexical scope) -- a let inside one mutates the outer name directly, confirmed across both an if-block (y: 1 -> 99) and a while-loop accumulating across iterations (z: 1 -> 31, not reset each iteration). Genuinely DIFFERENT from function bodies, which see no outer-scope let at all.
